title: Integrate existing console with central Prospectus accounts
description: Cross-project initiative Prospectus kanbus-4b25e2, epic kanbus-c32497, integration kanbus-e1dbe6. Reuse trace-ui and Python web_api. First increment: typed server-side accounts gateway, temporary-runtime-credential IAM SigV4 transport, fail-closed account/person/product authorization binding, synthetic specs. Live slice blocked on exact runtime hosting/persistence, runtime role approval, OAuth callback, and agreed read/write permission contract. No central database duplication.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Local increment complete: existing console retained; IAM SigV4 accounts client requires refreshing temporary credentials, forwards verified human access token, supports identity resolution and idempotent creation. Hosted injectable boundary authorizes every GraphQL read/write (including WebSocket) and timeline before selecting account-owned SQLite store; no shared-token/LAN fallback or global worker. Synthetic/API/session specifications pass; UI production build passes; loopback browser Alpha/Beta fixtures render with no warnings/errors. No Google/deployment proof. Reviewed inventory: no persistent compute host in cyclotron-production/us-east-1; no console Amplify app in east1/east2/west2. Deployment blocked for reviewed persistent Python runtime, separate Cognito client/callback, exact runtime IAM role/central registry and API. Parent recommendation: minimal persistent singleton Python host with retained encrypted EBS and temporary instance-profile credentials; Amplify-only cannot preserve Python/SQLite serialized-worker semantics. No provisioning performed. Related central initiative kanbus-4b25e2, epic kanbus-c32497, integration kanbus-e1dbe6.
